sentences.translation: There was a very poor young man in one place.
One day, the young man prayed to Kannon at the temple.
"Please enrich me."
After prayer, the young man found a straw on his way home.
"Let's take this and go on a journey."
The young man walked out holding on to the straw.
Then a single abu came flying.
"Please give me the straw, and I will give you a gift."
The young man took the straw and oranges again.
I walked again and met a traveler.
"I'll give you that sweet cloth, please."
The young man took the cloth with his pan.
I walked again and met a merchant.
"I'll give you the cloth, and I'll give you the horse in return."
The young man replaced the cloth and horse.
and then passed by the big house.
"Sell me the horse, and I will give you this house and rice field in return."
The young man replaced the horse and the house.
The young man began with a straw and finally became very rich.
Then the young man came to be called "warashibe choja" (literally, "the elder of straw").
